findings: `historical_glyphs.items[0].period` calls the oracle-script redraw “Shang oracle script style,” but its cited file evidence establishes only an oracle-script-style modern redraw and provides inscription identifiers without dating the redraw to the Shang. Replace the asserted Shang period with a qualified oracle-bone script style label, preserving that the image is a modern redraw and that the listed examples have no calendar date (X-b1c427be4f77ee03cccc, X-bbe80c0875b2b2ce8a9b).
